dimensions.note: Tokens are sensitive, come from a vault and are read-only in use. They are sent only to the forge, redirects are refused, and error messages carry no token. This commit does not change that.
runPrState logs entry and completion with structured placeholders, and warns when a read is incomplete. No sensitive values are logged.

github.ts line 202 fails a missing commit only on an open PR, so a merged PR with none reads as checks none with complete true. Use state !== "closed". Otherwise failures are listed per PR, and a run that read nothing throws before writing.

99 tests pass and the new paging and head tests are sound. Three cases are not covered, each reproduced with a throwaway fake: a status moving between Forgejo pages, a blank X-Total-Count, and a merged PR with no commit. The mismatched-head path has only fake coverage, as the change summary says.
Read-only. A rerun overwrites the same instance, and a run that read nothing leaves the last good record in place.

The X-Total-Count fix matches production: re-checked on swamp-extensions#666, with the real reader at page size 1 giving pages 1 and 2, total 2, 1 failed, complete true. Three gaps remain in forgejo.ts readStatuses. A status updated between pages is lost and another counted twice, reading as passing with complete true; throw on a repeated context. A blank header parses as total 0 and truncates; require /^\d+$/. A 200 body with no statuses reads as no checks; require an array, or null with total_count 0.
Response bodies are cancelled on redirect, retry and error paths. Each attempt has its own timeout, and the abort signal is honored.
The README names only public repositories and the public Forgejo host. Test fixtures use forge.example and ci.example. No IP addresses or internal hosts.
Plain z.object schemas with no passthrough. Mechanical check 1, schema-write conformance, passes: both readers populate every Pr field, and state carries prs, failures and complete.
The state resource has lifetime infinite and garbageCollection 10.
Read-only behaviors with one read method, not a CRUD lifecycle.
Mechanical check 3 passes: one method writes one instance, pr-state, in one shape. Mechanical check 4 passes: every schema field is written, and none is a placeholder.
pr_state reads no stored state back.

github and forgejo are new types, and lab's behavior version stays 2026.11.04.1 with no schema change. The dry run's upgrade warnings call for --skip-upgrade-check if these types have never been published. That publication history was not checked.
